words.gloss: those who have the guise or appearance

literal: Having become those who have the guise of those who have renounced, having entered and investigated, whatever is done to them, a spy is one without slip.
translation: Assuming the guise of holy ascetics, entering everywhere to investigate secrets, a true spy is one who never slips up or reveals their identity, no matter what is done to them.
modern: துறவிகளின் வேடத்தை ஏற்றுக்கொண்டு, பிறர் அறியாதவாறு புகுந்து உண்மைகளை ஆராய்ந்து, தமக்கு என்ன நேர்ந்தாலும் தன் மெய்ம்மையை வெளிப்படுத்தாத சோர்வில்லாத தன்மையைக் கொண்டிருப்பதே ஒற்றாகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the extreme operational methods and resilience required of a spy. A spy should adopt the disguise of ascetics ('துறந்தார் படிவத்தர்') because holy men have free access to all places without raising suspicion. They must enter deep into enemy territory ('இறந்து') to gather intelligence. Most importantly, even if they are caught, tortured, or interrogated ('என் செயினும்'), they must never lose their composure or slip up ('சோர்வு இலது') to betray their mission.
